rules.name: Acceptance criteria defined and testable
rules.description: Story must have at least one acceptance criterion. 'AC: TBD' or task-style bullet points do not count — criteria must describe outcomes.
rules.failMessage: Acceptance criteria are missing or not testable (e.g. task bullets instead of outcomes)

rules.name: Story points estimated
rules.description: Story must have story points assigned — field cannot be empty or 0.

rules.name: Assignee or component owner set
rules.description: Story must have at least one assignee or a component with a designated owner.
rules.failMessage: No assignee or component owner set

rules.name: Priority set
rules.description: Story must have a priority (High, Medium, Low) — not 'Unprioritized' or empty.

rules.name: Dependencies linked
rules.description: If the story depends on other work, those dependencies must be linked in Jira. No unresolved blocking issues.
rules.failMessage: Known dependencies are not linked in Jira

rules.name: User story format
rules.description: Description should follow 'As a [user], I want [goal], so that [benefit]' or clearly describe the user/business value.
rules.failMessage: Description does not articulate user or business value

rules.name: No unresolved open questions
rules.description: There must be no open clarifying questions in the comments that would block development from starting.

rules.name: Mockups or design attached (if UI story)
rules.description: If the story involves UI changes, a design link or attachment must be present.
rules.failMessage: UI story is missing design attachment or link
